overview: The committee addressed urgent infrastructure concerns at the McGlynn Elementary School, reviewed the superintendent's performance goals for the upcoming year, and received updates on student vaccination clinics.

items.title: Consent agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payroll, and minutes from the meeting of October 18, 2021.

items.title: Report of the Special Education and Behavioral Health Subcommittee
items.summary: Placed the subcommittee report on file following an update on initial goal-setting and a call for increased community participation.

items.title: Public comment on school bus driver contract
items.summary: A representative from Teamsters Local 25 requested the committee's support in urging Eastern Bus to negotiate a fair contract for Medford's school bus drivers.

items.title: Superintendent remarks
items.summary: Shared updates on staff professional development regarding implicit bias, student athletic successes, and local holiday observances.

items.title: Public health update
items.summary: Reported on rising COVID-19 case counts, the rollout of vaccine clinics for children aged 5 to 11, and educational support protocols for students in quarantine.

items.title: McGlynn Elementary facility concerns
items.summary: The committee requested an administrative report for the next meeting after a parent presented evidence of severe roof leaks and electrical hazards in kindergarten classrooms.

items.title: Superintendent goals 2021-2022
items.summary: Tabled the annual goals to allow for refinements to the measurable outcomes for early literacy and district equity initiatives.

items.title: Priority capital projects
items.summary: Reviewed a summary of completed and pending infrastructure repairs, with a focus on long-term strategic planning for building maintenance.

items.title: Family School Partnership Initiative audit
items.summary: Referred a state audit on family engagement to the Communication, Engagement, and Strategic Planning Subcommittee to evaluate future participation requirements.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for several community members, including a student and a district paraprofessional.
